styleSystem.description: Install components styled with Tailwind utilities or with plain scoped CSS.

tsConfigPath.description: tsconfig used to resolve path aliases.

setupTailwind.description: Whether init set up Tailwind CSS for this project.

cssPath.description: Stylesheet that holds the theme variables, relative to the project root.

config.description: Optional legacy tailwind.config.js referenced with @config. Leave empty for CSS-first Tailwind v4.

prefix.description: Prefix added to Tailwind utility classes.

components.description: Import alias for UI components, e.g. @/components/ui.

utils.description: Import alias for the cn() helper, e.g. @/lib/utils. Empty for the CSS style system.

blocks.description: Import alias for blocks. Defaults to a blocks folder next to the components folder.

lib.description: Import alias for registry:lib files. Defaults to the folder of utils.

composables.description: Import alias for composables. Defaults to <source root>/composables.

generatePreflight.description: Write a preflight.css reset for the CSS style system.

componentNaming.description: File naming for installed components. Directories are always kebab-case.

anyOf.description: URL or path template for registry items. {name} is replaced with the item name and {style} with the style system. ${ENV_VAR} placeholders are expanded.

url.description: URL or path template for registry items. {name} is replaced with the item name and {style} with the style system. ${ENV_VAR} placeholders are expanded.

params.description: Query parameters appended to the URL.

registries.description: Third-party registries, installed with sigma-ui add @namespace/item.
